title: Manufacturer Fleet Unit Incentive Credits on Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
Under Kessler Automotive Group's **Vehicle Purchase Agreements**, a qualifying fleet deal is credited with the manufacturer's fleet unit incentive. The credit is booked once on the deal as a payment credit.

## Which deals qualify

A qualifying fleet deal is a **Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement** in delivered or closed status that meets the volume test. The customer's delivered fleet units in the calendar year of the deal's delivery, counted including the deal itself, must reach the deal type's fleet volume minimum. Units delivered earlier in that calendar year are credited too once the threshold is reached.

For such a deal this policy sets the fleet unit incentive, and only for such a deal. Deal types whose fleet volume minimum is 0 earn none.

| Situation | Fleet unit incentive |
|---|---|
| Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement, delivered or closed, year's delivered fleet units (this deal included) at or above the fleet volume minimum | Credited under this policy |
| Earlier fleet unit of the same calendar year, once the year's count reaches the minimum | Credited too |
| Deal type whose fleet volume minimum is 0 | None |

## Invocation: `credit_fleet_incentive_b735a70c`

**Capability.** The tool credits the manufacturer fleet incentive to one fleet vehicle purchase deal. It books one payment credit with payment method `manufacturer_incentive` on the deal, dated the handling date, and the deal's balance due drops by the credited amount. The buyer sees the incentive credit on the deal statement and a lower balance due.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent first unlocks `credit_fleet_incentive_b735a70c` with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | The customer identifier (customer reference number) of the fleet buyer, as returned by the customer profile lookup | Identifier text |
| `purchase_deal_id` | The purchase deal identifier (deal reference number) of the fleet deal receiving the credit, as returned by the purchase deal lookup for the verified customer | Identifier text |
| `incentive_amount` | The incentive credited | US dollars as a decimal number greater than zero with 2 decimal places (cents); further digits are rounded half up to the cent, and the rounded amount is what is booked |

**Return.** On success the tool returns a string that starts with "Incentive credited". The string gives the credit reference, the deal reference, the amount credited (US dollars, 2 decimals), the payment method `manufacturer_incentive`, the credit date (YYYY-MM-DD, the handling date) and the deal's new balance due (US dollars, 2 decimals).

A string that starts with "Error:" means the amount was not greater than zero, and nothing was booked.
